assertions.text: SPEC.md has an explicit section covering goals — what the feature must accomplish.
SPEC.md has an explicit section covering non-goals or out-of-scope items.
SPEC.md lists concrete, testable requirements rather than restating ISSUE.md's vague text in list form.
